newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OCBC says OCBC Malaysia, Pacific talks off.
newsitem.headline: OCBC says OCBC Malaysia, Pacific talks off.

text.p: Oversea Chinese Banking Corporation Ltd (OCBC) said on Friday the proposed merger between OCBC Bank (Malaysia) and Pacific Bank had been terminated.
Complex issues regarding legal, accounting and regulatory requirements were difficult to resolve, OCBC said in a statement.

"As some of these issues still remain unresolved, it has been mutually agreed that it would be in the best interests of shareholders, customers and staff of the two banks not to continue the discussions any further," the statement said.
The operations of OCBC Bank (Malaysia) would not be affected by the termination of the merger talks, it added.
